formula: Sum projected lengths of network geometry plus both dotted entrance connectors (EPSG:32119, metres). Miles = total / 1609.344. Minutes = total / 80. Independently cross-check WGS84 ellipsoidal length.
limits: Checks distance along the drawn coordinates and endpoint continuity, not present-day walkability, best real-world path, door accuracy, crossing delays or historical 2022 conditions. Three origins are building-edge estimates.
